dialogues.speaker: Contarini
dialogues.text: *yawn* I was out for so long... But I'm still so sleepy... Why did I have such a strange dream...

dialogues.speaker: Contarini
dialogues.text: Me? Contarini Tiepolo, of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, at your service.

dialogues.speaker: Contarini
dialogues.text: I'm on leave at the moment, but if you encounter any violations of the law, please come straight to me anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Contarini
dialogues.text: *sigh* Well, I say that, but it's not often that I come out on vacation, and yet I haven't had enough rest at all... *yawn*

dialogues.speaker: Contarini
dialogues.text: That's right, and for some reason it was an especially strange one. In the dream, I was constantly fighting with these weird fellows. No different from work, really...

dialogues.speaker: Contarini
dialogues.text: There was a strange researcher from the Fontaine Research Institute in my dream who claimed that they had discovered the secret treasure of the Liliacruces Ordo, and planned to transform us all into clockwork meka...

dialogues.speaker: Contarini
dialogues.text: And not the normal kind, I'm talking about machines made of stone... I mean, it was a dream, right? Stone people don't really exist.

dialogues.speaker: Contarini
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, I've been losing sleep in the fight against those guys... I bet Captain Chevreuse would've had trouble with that, let alone me...

dialogues.speaker: Contarini
dialogues.text: Thanks for your kind words... *yawn* I guess I should head back and get some more sleep...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Secret treasure of the Liliacruces Ordo...?

dialogues.speaker: Contarini
dialogues.text: They claim that there was a secret organization several hundred years back known as the Liliacruces Ordo, and that they left behind a treasure in Petrichor that could make any wish come true.

dialogues.speaker: Contarini
dialogues.text: Sounds like exactly the sort of tale you'd tell to sucker tourists in, don't you think? But some still believe it... Like that Sumeru researcher over there.
